column1: # The font manifest P13d checks. Every file here is VENDORED -- present in this
# repository, not resolved from a system font path -- because the named catastrophe for
# this deliverable is a font that silently substitutes and moves the reflow.
# Source: TeX Live 2026, /usr/local/texlive/2026/texmf-dist. Licence: SIL Open Font Licence 1.1 (files carried alongside).
# The recipe MUST load these by PATH (fontspec Path=), never by family name: macOS ships
# its own STIX Two and Helvetica-class faces, and a name lookup can resolve to a
# different file with different metrics on a machine that looks identical.
# wealthTensor-94 (wt175): FreeSerif is vendored for FOUR CHARACTERS and nothing else --
# U+2713 CHECK MARK, U+29D7 BLACK HOURGLASS, U+270E PENCIL, U+26A0 WARNING SIGN. They are
# the citation-verification notation the References sections define in their own prose,
# they occur 126 times, and MEASURED against every one of the fifteen faces above they are
# carried by none of them. LaTeX sets nothing for an absent glyph and reports it as a log
# warning, so all 126 would have been silently absent from a build that exited 0.
# This ADDS a row under ADR-002's discipline (vendored, by path, verified by checksum);
# it does not re-open the decision. The body text never selects it -- only \wtmark does.
